issues.description: The getter for the StockIngredient name is named inconsistently across artifacts: the template repository defines getIngredientName(), while the solution repository defines getName(). The problem statement asks students to "add getters for all the private fields", but does not specify the exact getter names. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected getter name and may lead to inconsistent code or failing tests if other code expects a specific name.
issues.suggestedFix: Standardize the getter name across the template, solution, and any example code. Prefer the conventional getName() for the name field: rename getIngredientName() to getName() in the template and update all references (e.g., in Stock.findStockIngredient()) accordingly, or alternatively change the solution to use getIngredientName(). Update the problem statement to explicitly state the expected getter names if necessary.
